name: product
description: Explore product opportunities, synthesize evidence, model product domains, design and assess tests, and turn approved decisions into PRDs.

interface.longDescription: Expands product opportunities, clarifies users and outcomes, synthesizes traceable evidence, discovers product rules, separates test design from assessment, and writes PRDs only from approved decisions.
defaultPrompt: Brainstorm several product opportunities without treating them as validated.
Synthesize these interviews into traceable themes, contradictions, and open questions.
Turn the approved discovery results into a PRD without inventing missing decisions.
